notes:
Top-level CRM notes / call fragments:
- Account: regional operator for water+power distribution; heavy OT mix (SCADA, MODBUS) — wants zero-exfil model.
- Primary contact: CTO (Rachel Meyers), Secondary: OT architect (Eben Cole).
- Quote from CTO: "We cannot allow any model parameters or telemetry to leave our DMZ — must be fully air-gapped."
- Security asks: FIPS 140-2 HSM for key material, STIG checklist for nodes, NIST 800-53 mapping, audit logs retained 7+ years, ability to run monthly integrity scans.
- Network: strict OT/IT segregation. They will only allow installation work in a locked LZ with escorted access and signed STIG artifacts. Data diode preferred but evaluating approved vendor list.
- Models: prefer vetted open models (quantized), need offline model signing and provenance. Ask: ability to pin model sha and have reproducible serving without outbound checks.
- Performance: latency target 150-300ms for short chat-like telemetry prompts; throughput 50 concurrent inference sessions for maintenance-assistant batch jobs (windowed batching acceptable). Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for hardened stack + SLAs.
- POC acceptance criteria (from draft): 1) Airgap lab deployed with no outbound network flows, 2) HSM keywrap for model keys, 3) End-to-end trace showing request -> KV-cache hit/miss logic in offline mode, 4) Audit trail showing admin actions + role-based access, 5) Simple rerank/embedding task executed locally.
- Operational constraints: no automatic updates; all patches via signed bundles and customer-run install. Redwood must provide offline install package and detailed upgrade instructions.
- Procurement notes: finance needs final SOW + BOM. Expect 8-12 week procurement lead time after SOW sign.
- Risk flags: if Redwood requires any outbound telemetry by default, will be a showstopper. Need written guarantee that telemetry can be disabled.
- Internal AE notes: Try to bundle Dedicated capacity + Private install as phased deal: start with 4-week onprem pilot (billable) -> Dedicated reserved nodes if pilot passes -> enterprise contract + 3-year support.
- Suggested next call: week of 2026-03-15 with OT, procurement, and security to review SOW line items.
